extraction.notes: ESS reports FFO and Core FFO only; no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null. Three-month 2023 column used. Dash entries (Gains not included in FFO, Casualty loss, early debt retirement, co-investment promote, preferred equity redemption income) recorded as 0. Diluted shares printed as 66,445,256 units; divided by 1,000 to 66,445.256 thousands. Check: 245,369/66,445.256 = 3.69; 251,320/66,445.256 = 3.78. Category for 'Depreciation attributable to third party ownership and other (2)' (-371) and 'Tax expense (benefit) on unconsolidated co-investments' and 'Provision for credit losses' and 'G&A and other, net' and 'Co-investment promote income' set to 'other' as they fit no specific category. Reconciliation appears on seq 16 (printed S-3); the same figures also appear on seq 10 (printed 6). Recurring capex is not disclosed in these pages.
